title: Structure Preserving Approximation of Semiconcave Functions
summary: This article addresses structure-preserving smooth approximation of semiconcave functions. semiconcave functions are of particular interest because they naturally arise in a variety of variational problems, including {optimal feedback control, game theory, and optimal transport}. We leverage the fact that any semiconcave function can be represented as the {infimum of a countable family of \(C^2\) functions}.
